title: Move the free beta's end from December 31 to January 31, 2027, so the site matches the re-engagement emails

source.ref: Owner decision 2026-11-11: "Move Frequency's beta end from December 31 to January 31 before today's email?" -> "Yes, I'll build that PR too" (FlowWeb email queue thread).

detail: The founding and re-engagement emails say Frequency is free through January 31, 2027, while BETA_ENDS_ON said 2026-12-31. Moved BETA_ENDS_ON to 2027-01-31 and its label to 'January 31'; launch day (January 1, 2027) now falls inside the beta. Help pages for beta pricing, Collective and plans say 'before January 31'. The Collective Founding intro (COLLECTIVE_FOUNDING_ENDS_AT, January 1) is unchanged. Owner follow-up outside code: the beta grace window in /admin/pricing (pricing_settings.beta_grace) may still end December 31.
